identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I Clinical Study of Anti-CEA CAR-T Therapy in the Treatment of CEA-positive Advanced Malignant Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single-center, double-arm, open-label study. The study plans to set up 2 groups,Intravenous infusion group have 3 dose groups, adopting a dose-escalating 3+3 design, and plan to recruit about 9-18 subjects with CEA-positive advanced malignant solid tumors.Intraperitoneal injection group have 4 dose groups, adopting a dose-escalating 3+3 design, and plan to recruit about 12-24 subjects with CEA-positive advanced malignant solid tumors.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Adverse events after CEA-CAR-T cells infusion [Safety and Tolerability]
primaryOutcomes.description: Therapy-related adverse events were recorded and assessed according to the National Cancer Institute's Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE, Version 5.0)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Obtain the maximum tolerated dose of CEA-CAR-T cells[Safety and Tolerability]

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Disease control rate of CAR-T cell preparations in CEA-positive advanced malignancies [Effectiveness]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Disease control rate: including CR, PR and SD

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Changes in serum tumor markers of CAR-T cell preparations in CEA-positive advanced malignancies [Effectiveness]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Changes in serum tumor markers：CEA、 CA199、 CA125
AUCS is defined as the area under the curve in 28 days and 90 days
CMAX is defined as the highest concentration of CEA-CAR-T cells expanded in peripheral blood
TMAX is defined as the time to reach the highest concentration
The content of free CEA in peripheral blood at each time point measured by Chemiluminescence immunoassay

otherOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate (ORR) of CEA- CAR-T treatment in patients with CEA-positive advanced malignancies[Effectiveness]
Duration of Response (DOR) of CEA- CAR-T treatment in patients with CEA-positive advanced malignancies[Effectiveness]
otherOutcomes.description: DOR will be assessed from the first assessment of CR/PR/SD to the first assessment of recurrence or progression of the disease or death from any cause

otherOutcomes.measure: Progress-free survival(PFS) of CEA- CAR-T treatment in patients with CEA-positive advanced malignancies[Effectiveness]
otherOutcomes.description: PFS will be assessed from the first CEA-CAR-T cell infusion to death from any cause or the first assessment of progression.

otherOutcomes.measure: Overall survival(OS)of CEA- CAR-T treatment in patients with CEA-positive advanced malignancies[Effectiveness]
otherOutcomes.description: OS will be assessed from the first CEA-CAR-T cell infusion to death from any cause

otherOutcomes.measure: Proportion of tumor cells in tumor tissue of CEA- CAR-T treatment in patients with CEA-positive advanced malignancies
otherOutcomes.description: The rate of tumor cell in tumor tissue will be measured by biopsy and immunohistochemistry

otherOutcomes.measure: CEA expression level of CEA- CAR-T treatment in patients with CEA-positive advanced malignancies
otherOutcomes.description: The CEA expression in tumor tissue will be measured by biopsy and immunohistochemistry

otherOutcomes.measure: Changes in the number of tumor-infiltrating immune cells of CEA- CAR-T treatment in patients with CEA-positive
otherOutcomes.description: the number of tumor-infiltrating immune cells will be measured by biopsy and immunohistochemistry
